audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of 60 NPC preference, birthday, spouse mood, adoption and pregnancy strings. Male and female variants, slash branches, placeholders, dialogue commands, leading and trailing spaces, concatenated fragments and emotional tone were checked against the English source.
